frai-gate - the FRAI Gate: a Responsible AI Gate for specs

Usage:
  frai-gate init [--out <file>] [--ci]   Drop the RAI spec template into the repo (default: FRAI-SPEC.md);
                                         --ci also writes .github/workflows/rai-gate.yml so the gate
                                         runs on every PR
  frai-gate check <spec.md> [options]    Validate the spec's Responsible AI Gate
      --smart                            Add an AI quality review of the gate answers (Claude Agent SDK)
      --json                             Machine-readable output
      --summary                          Print only a one-line summary (e.g. "BLOCK 5/7: evaluation, transparency")
  frai-gate draft [--out <file>] [--print]
                                         Scan this repo with a read-only agent and draft a filled-in
                                         gate section grounded in the code (default out: rai-gate-draft.md)

Exit codes: 0 = PASS/WARN, 1 = BLOCK, 2 = usage/error.
The smart commands (draft, check --smart) use the Claude Agent SDK and need Claude Code
authentication or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Model override: FRAI_GATE_MODEL (default claude-opus-5).

- Formats as `<VERDICT> <answered>/<total>` where total=7
- Appends `: ` followed by blocked check ids (comma-space separated, in GATE_CHECKS order) when blocks exist
- Example outputs:
  - `PASS 7/7` (all good)
  - `WARN 7/7` (warnings only, no blocks)
  - `BLOCK 5/7: evaluation, transparency` (two checks blocked)

- Prints only the one-line summary instead of full report
- Exit codes unchanged (1 on BLOCK, 0 otherwise)
- `--json` takes priority if both flags specified

### 3. **Updated HELP text** with documentation and example usage

### 4. **Added comprehensive test suite** (`src/gate/report.test.ts`)
- 7 tests covering all scenarios: missing section, passing gate, warnings, multiple blocks, deduplication, order preservation

### 5. **Exported from public API** (`src/index.ts`)

- 2 test files, 18 total tests
- No compilation errors
- CLI help includes the new flag
